name: Yakitori Ichimatsu
dinnerNote: Hinai chicken course (pairing of five sakes and wines ¥5,500 more); tax included

menus.name: Hinai chicken course
menus.note: Charcoal-grilled Hinai-jidori chicken kaiseki; with five matched sakes and wines ¥20,000 in all; tax included

bookingOpens: Online through OMAKASE, where the course is paid in advance, or by phone.
cancellation: Guests more than 30 minutes late are treated as a cancellation.
groups: An L-shaped counter of eight and a semi-private room for four.
dressCode: Smart casual: no T-shirts, shorts or sandals.
duration: About two hours: sittings at 4pm and 6:30pm, plus 9pm on Fridays and Saturdays.
